_comment: A fallback for the Pro Bowl picks, for when the Google Sheet cannot be read or has something wrong in it. Copy this file to <season>.json - 2026.json for the 2026 season - and fill in the names. A file named for the season OVERRIDES the sheet completely, so delete it again once the sheet is right. This file, TEMPLATE.json, is never read.
_names: Write a player as Sleeper has him, or as anything listed under pro_bowl.aliases in league.config.json. A defence is its nickname: Rams, Texans. Leave a slot blank until it is picked. The build prints any name it cannot place.
